querystring.select: SELECT RMC.DESCR AS VendorCategory, V.IS_ACTIVE AS IsActive, V.VENDOR_CODE AS VendorCode, V.TAXPAYER_NO AS TaxpayerNo,V.VENDOR_NAME AS VendorName, V.MR_VENDOR_TYPE_CODE AS MrVendorTypeCode, RMT.DESCR AS VendorType, V.TAX_ID_NO AS TaxIdNo
querystring.from: FROM dbo.VENDOR V LEFT JOIN REF_MASTER RMC ON V.MR_VENDOR_CATEGORY_CODE = RMC.MASTER_CODE AND RMC.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'VENDOR_CATEGORY' LEFT JOIN REF_MASTER RMT ON V.MR_VENDOR_TYPE_CODE = RMT.MASTER_CODE AND RMT.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'VENDOR_TYPE'
